jobs.prompt: Single character model sheet on ONE 16:9 landscape canvas. A young adult Asian woman in her early twenties, contemporary urban setting. Shoulder-length straight dark brown hair with a light fringe, a softly rounded oval face, slightly downturned outer eye corners, subtle makeup and pale fingers. A light ivory round-neck short-sleeved knee-length dress in soft cotton-blend fabric, narrow waist seam, clean finished edges and ivory flat shoes. Neatly maintained clothing, no jewelry or medical gown. Relaxed upright posture and a tentative open expression. The LEFT 34 percent contains one large three-quarter half-body portrait establishing facial identity. LIGHTING IN THE LEFT ZONE ONLY: soft directional key and cool fill. The RIGHT upper area contains three equally tall FULL-BODY figures of the SAME woman: front, exact side profile, and back; all complete from crown to shoe soles with generous margins. LIGHTING IN THE RIGHT ZONES: flat even neutral light for orthographic inspection. The RIGHT lower detail strip has four small studies: hair arrangement, eyebrow and eye shape, neckline and clean seam, and shoe shape. PROPORTIONS ARE CRITICAL: natural consistent head-to-body ratio, equal leg and torso proportions across the three views; never stretch or compress the body to fit. If space is tight, the detail studies give way, not the figures. Pure white background, no panel labels, no text, no scene, no additional people. Every zone depicts the same character. The full-body views are front view, side profile and back view.
